title: Mixed Event — This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day — Episode3 Animal Excitement

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day
meta.Event Outline: Fresh second-years Minori and Shiho are on the animal caretaker committee, and their work has already begun. When they learn about a shadowing opportunity at Odaiba Animal Land from a teacher, they decide to participate. Animal antics ensue!

rows.Line: A few minutes later
Grassland Area - Back Office

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My name is Minori Hanasato and I attend Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy! It's nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm Shiho Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much for giving us this opportunity to help take care of the animals today!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Thank you both as well.
Welcome to the Grassland Area. My name is Nakazawa. I look after the animals here.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: I'll be working with the two of you all day, so please don't be afraid to ask me any questions that you have.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: I'm sure you two have already heard, but you'll be looking after the shoebill and chipmunks today.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
We'll begin by measuring out their food.
Why don't we start with the shoebill?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, the shoebill?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess it eats fish?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Yes, we feed our shoebill rainbow trout and carp, but the ones in the wild survive on a staple of catfish and lungfish.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, catfish? But those are so big...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's amazing! They can really gobble them up whole...?! It'd take me at least three bites!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not sure that's something to brag about.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Hehe. That's not the only surprising fact about them. Shoebills are also known to eat snakes, frogs...and even baby crocodiles.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Baby crocodiles?!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Yes, and because they don't have any teeth, they swallow them whole as you said. In that sense, they're very remarkable creatures.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, my assumptions about them are starting to change.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Are we gonna be okay...?!
What if it tries to eat me...?!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: You should be fine since there have never been any reported cases of shoebills eating people. Also, they're very docile animals.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Yes!
I'm sure you'll understand when we go to feed our shoebill, Schubert.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Now, let's get his trout ready.
Shoebills don't actually have that big of an appetite compared to some other animals, so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Throw the last one into the bucket, and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, that should be it!
We're all set to feed Schubert!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All we did was move the fish into these buckets. I'm not sure that's anything to be proud about...

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: The chipmunks' feed is also relatively simple to prepare, so this area isn't too bad in that department by comparison.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: We have a pygmy hippo just over there in a different area, which is apparently quite a handful.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: I'm told it needs to be given two to three fifteen-kilogram meals per day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It eats that much?!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: And that's supposed to be on the low side. Elephants apparently eat five times that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Eep...!
I guess big bodies mean big appetites!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm kinda glad we were assigned to this area.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Oh, although some animals are easier to feed than others, they're all hard work to clean up after, so be prepared.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right!
We've done a lot of that for our school's animal caretaker committee, so we should be able to handle that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, we're not talking about a rabbit cage here.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Ah, that's wonderful to hear!
Actually, about how we'll be cleaning...

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: I'd like for one of you to clean Schubert's habitat and the other to clean the chipmunks'.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Please talk it over and decide which you'll be cleaning.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Which do you wanna do, Shiho?!
I'm okay with either—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The chipmunks.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll take the chipmunks!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
You take the chipmunks! I'll take Schubert!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Oh, that was quick...
I thought you were going to decide after having a chance to feed the animals.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Anyway, we're all set to go, so let's head over to where Schubert is!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow... We finally get to meet Schubert!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is gonna be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Nod*
Shoebill Habitat

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-This is Schubert...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I knew shoebills were big...
But he's really, really big up close!
He's about up to my shoulder!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Also...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
He's so calm and collected.
It's like he isn't bothered at all by our presence.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, meanwhile I jump whenever someone I've never met walks into the green room!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, not something to brag about...

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Okay, now that you've met Schubert...

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Let's get straight to the fun part of today's program. Feeding the animals!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-We finally get to feed Schubert...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How do we actually do that?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
You'll be feeding him by hand!
Put one of the trout in the palm of your hand and offer it to him like a present.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By hand...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I-I-I-Is that really okay?!
You just said shoebills eat baby crocodiles! What if he tries to chomp off our fingers...?!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Remember, he wouldn't be able to since shoebills don't have any teeth. You'll be fine as long as he doesn't chomp down really hard.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: You'll need to go one at a time. Which of you would like to go first...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uhh, I... I...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll go first.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sh-Shiho?!
Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, since he seems pretty docile...
Also, chances like this don't come around often.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's the spirit!
Then, for our brave Ms. Hinomori, here's a trout!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Exhale*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Here, Schubert.
It's time to eat.
se_event_keeper_2023_004

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa...!
